headline: A touchdown for the Chiefs!
what_happened: P.Mahomes threw a 13-yard pass to T.Kelce for a touchdown, which is worth 6 points.
who: P.Mahomes connected with T.Kelce for the score.
why_it_matters: This is great news for the Chiefs as it puts them ahead by 2 points. It also increases their chance of winning the game by 6 percentage points.
pop_culture: After T.Kelce scored his first touchdown of the season, Taylor Swift pointed to her wedding ring and cheered for her husband.
